results.heading: Price list — what treatments cost
results.text:
All prices are in Turkish lira and include VAT. These are the fees for standard treatments.

- Check-up and consultation: ₺900
- Hygiene visit (scale and polish): ₺1,500
- Composite filling (per tooth): ₺2,000 – ₺3,500 depending on size
- Teeth whitening (in-clinic): ₺6,000
- Panoramic X-ray: ₺700

results.heading: Estimates
results.text: Prices for crowns, implants and orthodontics are given after an examination; we send a written estimate by email before any treatment starts.

results.heading: Payment
results.text: We accept cash, debit and credit cards. Treatment plans above ₺10,000 can be paid in three instalments with no interest.

args.subject: Re: Whitening quote and VAT
args.body:
Dear Üsame,

Thank you for your question. All our prices are in Turkish lira and include VAT. So the in-clinic teeth whitening fee of ₺6,000 is the full price, with no additional tax added at the clinic.

If you would like to go ahead, just reply with a day or time that suits you (you mentioned you prefer mornings) and we will arrange a booking for you.

Warm regards,
Nova Dental Clinic reception
